study.title: Synthesis and Biological Evaluation of Urea Derivatives as Highly Potent and Selective Rho Kinase Inhibitors
study.article_method_location: article PDF page 12 (ROCK-I/II Assays paragraph; extracted text section headed ROCK-I/II Assays)
study.si_method_location: supporting information PDF page 4, section 2.1 Screening

assay.target_identity: The urea article reports a ROCK-I/II biochemical assay and separately tabulates ROCK-II inhibitor IC50 values.

species_and_construct.basis: The urea SI states that all active enzymes except ROCK-II 1-543 were purchased from Upstate and that ROCK-II 1-543 was cloned and purified as described earlier. The cited earlier protocol is Schröter et al. and explicitly describes cloning amino acids 1-543 of human ROCK-II from human brain RNA as an N-terminal 6-His/TEV construct expressed in Sf9 cells.
species_and_construct.caveat: The 2013 article's ROCK-I/II paragraph does not independently repeat the species or cloning details, and it does not provide a ROCK-II catalog number. Treat human 1-543 as the referenced construct identity, while retaining uncertainty about whether the commercial/assay lot was sequence-identical to the cited preparation.

assay.vendor_and_system: Cisbio STK2 kinase system; ROCK-I listed as Upstate #14-601; ROCK-II vendor/catalog not stated in the article paragraph.
assay.plate_and_dispensing: 384-well plate; 5 uL substrate/ATP mixture dispensed with BioRAPTR FRD Workstation; 20 nL test compound dispensed with a 384-head offline Pintool system.

substrate.reported_input: 1 uM STK2 substrate in the initial 5 uL mixture
substrate.calculated_reaction_final: 0.5 uM, assuming the stated 5 uL mixture is combined with 5 uL enzyme solution without other volume changes

atp.rock_ii_reported_input: 20 uM ATP in the initial 5 uL mixture
atp.rock_ii_calculated_reaction_final: 10 uM ATP in the 10 uL reaction
atp.rock_i_reported_input: 4 uM ATP in the initial 5 uL mixture
atp.rock_i_calculated_reaction_final: 2 uM ATP in the 10 uL reaction
atp.calculation_basis: The article says 5 uL mixture followed by 5 uL enzyme solution; these are dilution calculations, not separately reported final concentrations.

incubation_and_readout.stop_and_detection: Add 10 uL of 1X antibody and 62.5 nM Sa-XL in Detection Buffer; incubate a further 1 h at room temperature
incubation_and_readout.instrument_and_mode: ViewLux plate reader in HTRF mode
incubation_and_readout.endpoint: Dose-response IC50 values for ROCK-I/ROCK-II inhibition
incubation_and_readout.concentration_caveat: The article gives antibody/Sa-XL concentrations for the added detection solution and does not clarify whether those values are intended as premix or final-well concentrations after the 10 uL addition.

cited_protocol.citation: Schröter T et al., Comparison of Miniaturized Time-Resolved Fluorescence Resonance Energy Transfer and Enzyme-Coupled Luciferase High-Throughput Screening Assays to Discover Inhibitors of Rho-Kinase II (ROCK-II), Journal of Biomolecular Screening 13 (2008) 17-28
cited_protocol.retrieval: Official Sage HTML/PDF pages were queried; the PDF endpoint returned HTTP 403 through the storage wrapper, so no local copy or hash is asserted. Official indexed page text directly supports the human 6-His ROCK-II 1-543 construct.
cited_protocol.method_relevance: The cited protocol contains both TR-FRET and luciferase formats. The urea article specifically reports the Cisbio STK2 HTRF implementation; its ROCK assay should not be conflated with the cited paper's luciferase assay.

supporting_information_findings.result: The SI adds the explicit statement that ROCK-II 1-543 was cloned and purified as described earlier and that other active enzymes were purchased from Upstate. It does not provide a different ROCK-II ATP, incubation, or HTRF readout condition.

validation_implications: Treat this as a biochemical HTRF IC50 assay with final ROCK-II ATP approximately 10 uM and final enzyme approximately 0.25 nM under the stated volume arithmetic.
Do not pool its values with ROCK2 assays using different ATP, construct, substrate, readout, or assay vendor without an assay-stratified analysis.
For a retrospective benchmark, preserve the article's assay provenance and censoring/replicate metadata; the article paragraph alone does not establish lot identity or full plate-level controls.
uncertainties: The article cites, rather than reproduces, the construct-generation protocol; exact assay-lot sequence identity is unresolved.
The article does not specify the ROCK-II vendor/catalog number in the ROCK-I/II paragraph.
The article does not state whether antibody/Sa-XL concentrations are before or after the stop-solution dilution.
This methods review does not independently audit compound structures or count eligible ROCK-II molecules.
